before.prompt: If Gold 1 follows your inward move, which response could help?

options.text: Call for a pass without looking at Gold 1
Reoffer elsewhere or make room for C
Remain still because your first move should have worked

before.explanation: A supporter should update the option; the first movement does not guarantee availability.

after.prompt: D1 is comparing the two Navy receivers. Looking at both gold defenders, which direct passing line has more room around it in this view?

options.text: The pass from D1 to YOU
The pass from D1 to C

after.explanation: The line from D1 to C has more space from the nearest gold defender. Gold 1 sits much nearer the line to YOU. C is an option for D1 to assess while YOU continue offering support; YOU do not have to receive the next pass. This still frame does not prove either pass will succeed. The line to YOU may become useful as the players move.

optionReasons.reason: YOU are a real teammate and viable future support option, but Gold1 lies very close to the direct puck-to-YOU line. The visible line has less space from its nearest defender than C’s line.
C is a real teammate. The minimum gap from either shown gold skater to the direct line is larger than the corresponding minimum for YOU. The comparison does not prove safety or demand a pass.

geometry.method: Canonical makeScene rendered puck, player receiving centres, finite direct-pass segments and Euclidean point-to-segment minimum distances. No player motion or pass simulated.

duplicateAudit.distinction: q7 identifies Gold1 near YOUR line; new q5 compares two genuine receiving options and considers both defenders. q6/q10 discuss helping C but do not perform this line comparison.

limits: Two genuine same-category choices used; no third real receiving option exists in these selected-player scenes. Chance success is 50%; response is not mastery proof.
Static point geometry does not encode stick reach, body width, skating, passing speed, gaze, interceptions or receiver readiness.
No scene setup or actor moved; no hypothetical event presented as visible.
Q003 phrasing room around line means spacing to the shown gold skaters, not obstruction by every rink feature. Neither compared segment intersects a net or boards.
No rendered/mobile check by author. Exact candidate needs independent content and visual checks.
